Do not drive if your blood glucose is less than
5 mmol/L. If your reading is between 4 and
5 mmol/L, eat a small starchy snack like 2 plain
biscuits or a piece of fruit. If your blood glucose is
less than 4 mmol/L, treat the hypo and do not drive
for at least 45 minutes after you have recovered.
